I have been addicted to meth for 8 years now. It has caused me to lose a marriage house and kids. I am on my second marriage and I pick up and use the the whole amount at once every week. I love it. I hate it. I don't mind getting lost for a day but the 2 days after kill me. Anxiety and constantly trying to get get off sexually. I have picked up somewhere being sexually submissive and doing some high risk sexual escapades outside. Its helped me cope with being depressed when I started however 8 years later it's all I know. I want to hate it I really do but I cant figure out how.
